decisions.reason: The firm publicly launched the anamnesis app as 'the new product line' on a page of its own, so it has invested heavily and committed visibly, and the app fits its announced digital, connected-practice direction.

The education institute builds on the firm's existing training content and its relationships with dental practices, so its costs are modest and it is easy to justify as part of customer support, even though public commitment to it is limited.
The remote screen-sharing tool is a low-investment, only briefly mentioned add-on, but it supports the firm's core service, so there is little reason to withdraw it despite weak public commitment.
